integrity: The primary source was inspected at its general sharp Schwarz theorem, optimality theorem, and full polydisk equality example. The earlier unit-polydisk Schwarz paper was inspected in full at its sharp constant and F_{t,k} example. The new equality locus follows by exact substitution into the displayed metric and a complete equality-condition analysis, with no numerical experiment.
scientific_limitations: The equality locus is classified only for the explicit rank-one extremal map on the polydisk metric family F_{t,k}; no classification of all sharp self-maps is claimed. The equality factor is the Lu constant, not the unit-factor rigidity condition.
title: Global line-subbundle saturation of the sharp Finsler Schwarz bound
